description: Material moved out of the active tree by 'git mv' (history preserved: git log --follow <new_path>).  Nothing was deleted or rewritten.  Obsolete experiments, historical campaign / validation analysis and historical result sets of the controller variants that preceded the single controller B2 (B0 = the same controller with the communication disabled).  The scripts need removed configuration options (payload-free, no neighbour adaptation) or the historical run matrices to run: reproduce them from the tag or commit named in each item.  Raw run logs are not in the repository (local archives, named in the descriptions).
verify: python scripts/verify_legacy_index.py  (sha256 and git_blob are over the content with CRLF normalised to LF; tests/test_legacy_index.py runs the same check)
